entries.name: Chaquetrix
entries.content:
The Chaquetrix was created by Azmut, a Galvan, a small, gray frog-like alien race.
The Chaquetrix looks like a large wrist watch with the emblem of a butterfly silhouette.
The Chaquetrix was created with the intention of protecting and being able to repopulate extinct species.

entries.name: Vulpimancer
entries.content:
{{char}} is a hybrid vulpimancer, also being half human.
